steps.title: Projection line block: extrude the block
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as projection_block.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane (the front). Draw a rectangle 45 wide and 25 high, corner on the origin. Add the 45 and 25 dimensions with the Dimension tool.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Profile = the rectangle, Distance 20. OK.

steps.title: Projection line block: cut the step
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the front face. Draw a rectangle from 20 along the top edge to the right end, 6 deep.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Profile = the rectangle, Cut, Through All. OK. Save.
steps.note: Only the 45 is given on the slide; the 25 height, the 20 x 6 step and the 20 depth are scaled from it.
